text: An eight-legged keeper of broken songs. Its bite slows prey.
Echo Weavers creep across the March Steppe, the Crystal Fields and the Reed Fen. The Unsung also calls them in its Chorus.
It has **26 health** and **3 armour** and bites for **4**, slowing you for 3 seconds. It never places webs or damages your camp.
pages.title: Where and how

text: Echo Silk binds into 2 Spiritweave under Water.
pages.title: What it gives

text: Reach **Voice** with the **Loom-stitchers**, then use a Bonding Charm on an adult: two tries in five, charm spent on failure.
A bonded weaver picks up drops around it and tosses them to you. See [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts).
